acquisition: Local copies obtained through a public sibling-repository bridge because the official DrivenData data tab redirected the unauthenticated sandbox to login. This is not represented as an authenticated official download.

example_submission.tif.role: grid/footprint template only; pixel values are not treated as truth

existing_faults.tif.role: known-label mask; used only for exact-pixel suppression and exact holdout masking

derived_sgmc_faults_100m_u8.tif.role: owner-derived local validation proxy only; provenance not independently verified; never used in H1/H2/H2-B construction

irregularity: The mirrored example template contains positive known-label pixels although the official page describes an all-zero example. The raster is used for grid/footprint only; labels are read from the separate known-label raster.
